biocs.name: Uncommon AppleScript with Defense-Evasion Command
biocs.description: Detection of AppleScript process that executes a command with potential defense-evasion behavior
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'osascript'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'sh'
| filter action_file_path contains 'do shell script'
